textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 7 science · Earth, Moon and the Sun · Textbook Concepts
textbookBox.concept: Earth spins on its axis once in 24 hours. This is rotation and it causes day and night. Earth also goes around the Sun once in about 365 and a quarter days. This is revolution.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: Earth spins on its axis once in 24 hours. This is rotation and it causes day and night. Earth also goes around the Sun once in about 365 and a quarter days. This is revolution. Earth's axis is tilted.
beats.speakEn: Earth spins on its axis once in 24 hours. This is rotation and it causes day and night. Earth also goes around the Sun once in about 365 and a quarter days. This is revolution. Earth's axis is tilted.

beats.en: When the northern part of Earth is tilted towards the Sun it gets more direct light for longer and has summer. When it is tilted away it has winter.
beats.speakEn: When the northern part of Earth is tilted towards the Sun it gets more direct light for longer and has summer. When it is tilted away it has winter.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 7 science · Earth, Moon and the Sun · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: The Moon shines by reflecting sunlight. As it goes round Earth in about a month we see different parts of its lit side, called phases.

beats.en: The Moon shines by reflecting sunlight. As it goes round Earth in about a month we see different parts of its lit side, called phases.
beats.speakEn: The Moon shines by reflecting sunlight. As it goes round Earth in about a month we see different parts of its lit side, called phases.

beats.en: A solar eclipse occurs when the Moon comes between the Sun and Earth and blocks the Sun's light. A lunar eclipse occurs when Earth comes between the Sun and Moon and its shadow falls on the Moon.
beats.speakEn: A solar eclipse occurs when the Moon comes between the Sun and Earth and blocks the Sun's light. A lunar eclipse occurs when Earth comes between the Sun and Moon and its shadow falls on the Moon.
